programme_facts.value: Department of Accounting & Finance

The Department of Accounting and Finance is one of four constituent Departments in the Kemmy Business School at the University of Limerick. The Department has responsibility for the disciplines of accounting, finance, risk management and insurance, taxation and corporate social responsibility.
Faculty in the Department of Accounting and Finance have a variety of professional and academic qualifications, experience working in practice and in industry.

This strongly underpins the achievement of excellence and relevance in the teaching of the core disciplines, providing students with knowledge and skills that will guarantee that they are at the cutting edge of a rapidly changing business world, now and into the future.
The department has close links with industry, the professional bodies in accounting, tax and insurance, and the public sector.

Department of Management and Marketing

The Department of Management and Marketing is one of four departments within the Kemmy Business School and encompasses a teaching and research community across the disciplines of Marketing, Management, Information Management, Communications, Project Management and Entrepreneurship.

The Department makes a strong contribution to the Bachelor of Business Studies Programmes (BBS) undergraduate and graduate programmes of the Kemmy Business School and delivers modules across disciplines to non-business students.
We offer a suite of Postgraduate programmes.
The Department has an active research culture, much of which is conducted in collaboration with a range of industry partners in private and public sectors.

International Human Resource Management, Cross-cultural management, Intercultural issues in management, Marketing and Business Strategy, Customer Value, Marketing Resources and Capabilities, Branding, Services and Relationship Marketing, E-service quality, Interactivity and e-relationship marketing, Consumer Culture Theory, Marketing Leadership theory, Marketing in profit and non-profit sectors, Entrepreneurship Education and Social Entrepreneurship.
Faculty have won prestigious regional and national Excellence in Teaching Awards.
The department holds regular seminars and conferences and contributes to public discourse through expert commentary featured in print, radio and online media.
